name: agent-residue-evidence
description: Local task-scoped residue evidence for Agent testing and build workflows

interface.shortDescription: Show task-scoped test and build residue without cleaning it.
interface.longDescription: Observe explicit task roots locally, give the Agent an evidence list after tests or builds, and verify the same stable candidates after user-authorized cleanup. The plugin never deletes files, stops processes, closes ports, scans the whole machine, or uses the network.
interface.defaultPrompt: Observe residue for this testing or build task, present evidence for review, and verify only after I authorize and the Agent performs any cleanup.
